teaser.en: Hunters once used the sticky milk of this hairy fig as glue, fixing feathers onto arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Zamani wawindaji walitumia utomvu unaonata wa mkuyu huu wenye manyoya kama gundi, kubandika manyoya ya ndege kwenye mishale.

summary.en: *Uuzi kaha* is the lowveld fig, a hairy-leaved fig of the bush and forest edge that runs with sticky latex. That latex was used to glue the feathers onto arrows.
summary.sw: *Uuzi kaha* (kwa Kiingereza *lowveld fig*) ni mkuyu wenye majani yenye vinyweleo, wa vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu, unaotiririka utomvu unaonata. Utomvu huo ulitumika kubandika manyoya kwenye mishale.

about.en: *Uuzi kaha* is a fig tree, and like all figs it bleeds a milky latex when a leaf or twig is broken; in this species the latex flows freely. The leaves and young twigs are covered in soft hairs. The small, rounded figs grow in pairs where the leaves join the twigs.
about.sw: *Uuzi kaha* ni mti wa jamii ya mikuyu, na kama mikuyu yote hutoa utomvu kama maziwa jani au kitawi kinapovunjwa; kwa spishi hii utomvu hutiririka kwa wingi. Majani na vitawi vichanga vimefunikwa na vinyweleo laini. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo huota kwa jozi mahali majani yanapoungana na vitawi.

where.en: It grows in bushland and along forest edges. Its paired figs and hairy leaves set it apart from the other wild figs of the coast.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu. Matunda yake yanayoota kwa jozi na majani yenye vinyweleo huutofautisha na mikuyu mingine ya porini ya pwani.

uses.en: The sticky latex was used to glue feathers onto arrow shafts, a small but essential job in making arrows that fly straight.
uses.sw: Utomvu wake unaonata ulitumika kubandika manyoya kwenye vijiti vya mishale, kazi ndogo lakini muhimu katika kutengeneza mishale inayokwenda moja kwa moja.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *uuzi kaha*, and *chiganda ulimbo*, which is shared with Duruma and means 'fig with latex' (*ulimbo* is sticky latex or birdlime). In English it is the lowveld fig. Swahili uses the general fig name *mkuyu*, which in Digo belongs to the Cape fig (*Ficus sur*).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *uuzi kaha*, na *chiganda ulimbo*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kiduruma na lina maana ya 'mkuyu wenye utomvu' (*ulimbo* ni utomvu unaonata au ulimbo wa kunasia ndege). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *lowveld fig*. Kiswahili kinatumia jina la jumla la mikuyu, *mkuyu*, ambalo katika Kidigo ni la *Ficus sur* (kwa Kiingereza *Cape fig*).

reason.en: Rubber vine, another plant valued for its latex
reason.sw: Mpira, mtambaa mwingine unaothaminiwa kwa utomvu wake
